family.description: Members of this family act as galactosyltransferases, belonging to glycosyltransferase family 92 [[cite:PUB00075505],[cite:PUB00075506],[cite:PUB00075507]]. The aligned region contains several conserved cysteine residues and several charged residues that may be catalytic residues. This is supported by the inclusion of this family in the GT-A glycosyl transferase superfamily.
family.name: Glycosyltransferase family 92

causal_graphs.context: Joint reaction of 0.5 ul extract, 1 mM UDP-Gal and 40 uM dabsyl-GEN[GnGnF6]R in 2.5 ul, MES pH6.5 with MnCl2, 2 h at room temperature. HTML prints MES 40 uM and MnCl2 10 uM; those unusual units remain unresolved, not silently corrected to mM.

evidence.explanation: Expression/transferase Methods and visually inspected Figure 2A-C support the net extract reaction and product assignment; no purified enzyme or independently inspected S3 claim.

edges.mechanism: The complete reaction adds 162 Da to parent2207, yielding2369; MS/MS fragment1273 locates the added hexose with core fucose, and beta-galactosidase removes it. Empty-vector and donor-omission controls lack the product.
edges.subject: galt1-extract-donor-acceptor

causal_graphs.family_mapping: GALT-1/M03F8.4 maps to O16374, 425 aa, current PF01697 189-394. Historical NP_504545.2 matches the reference and predates the study; the complete experimental clone is not independently verified. N-terminal membrane/glycosylation regions extend outside the domain.
causal_graphs.limitations: DIRECT describes the joint biochemical preparation-to-product observation, not autonomous purified GALT-1 chemistry. Figure 2B's caption reverses the displayed precursor order; use parent masses. The exact beta1,4 assignment additionally cites uninspected 2009 supplement S3. No elementary catalytic steps or family-wide substrate specificity are established.

evidence.explanation: Figure 5B EDTA/Mn/vector bars and Methods specifying replacement at equal concentration.

edges.mechanism: EDTA replacing MnCl2 lowers the readout near the vector-control baseline. It is not an EDTA-on-top-of-Mn experiment or proof of literally zero transfer.

causal_graphs.family_mapping: The extract contains whole C. elegans GALT-1/O16374-associated protein, PF01697 189-394 in a 425-aa reference. Altering the reaction environment is not residue-specific evidence for D289/D291 coordination.
causal_graphs.limitations: Readout is product-associated neutral-fraction radioactivity, with possible hydrolysis background. Water-added extract retains residual cofactors and is not metal-free. Three to seven independent experiments with SD do not establish a significant Mn/Fe/Co ranking, an exclusive Mn requirement or a purified-enzyme metal-binding mechanism.

record.description: Members of this family act as galactosyltransferases, belonging to glycosyltransferase family 92 [[cite:PUB00075505],[cite:PUB00075506],[cite:PUB00075507]]. The aligned region contains several conserved cysteine residues and several charged residues that may be catalytic residues. This is supported by the inclusion of this family in the GT-A glycosyl transferase superfamily.

evidence.explanation: Product, donor, acceptor, metal and rescue comparisons are supported, but the printed MES/metal units, historical clone and supplemental beta1,4 analysis need further inspection. All biochemical assays use raw Sf9 extract.
The pmk-1 phenotype and selected glycan deficit are supported with exon2 allele mapping and peak structural analysis. Lectin staining used fut-8 and cannot be transferred to galt-1.

discussions.notes: Verify 2009 supplemental primers/S3 and assay units using an accessible primary copy; current PMC PDF returned HTML, publisher403 and ETH429. Distinguish exact long NP_504545.2 mapping from unverified historical clones, putative DXD chemistry from residue tests, and apparent crude-extract Km from intrinsic constants. Inspect purified enzyme, other alleles and matched glycome rescue when available. Pigeon PMID19959475 and Populus GalS1 PMID36849618 are unintegrated family leads; do not transfer nematode core-fucose specificity to plant galactan extension/capping. Status remains IN_PROGRESS with partial scientific self-review, not family completion.
discussions.prompt: Resolve GALT-1 assay and construct gaps, and extend GT92 member coverage independently.
discussions.rationale: Eight graphs retain fifteen observed effects across crude-extract biochemistry, two genetic backgrounds, joint-construct rescue and a selected glycan fraction. Neither the full protein's isolated PF01697 domain nor every GT92 member has a resolved causal mechanism.
